specs: Passenger Limitations For the safety of all our passengers we enforce the following flight restrictions: All passengers must be 6 years of age or older.
Age 6-18 requires parent or guardian to fly.
Maximum weight per passenger cannot exceed 280 lbs / 127 Kilograms / 20 stone, passengers may be asked to be weighed for accuracy at check-in.
Also, everyone flying must be in good physical shape, no recent surgeries, no currently broken bones, no current pregnancies, and no hip or knee replacements within the last 2 years.
The actual coupon or certificate must be presented on flight day or standard pricing will apply If we can be of further assistance, please don't hesitate to call.
Third-party bookings If your flight was purchased through a third party, all cancellations and refunds must be handled directly through them.
